frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Comonotonic prospects share one complete ranking of events so each event keeps a fixed rank; on a comonotonic set the rank-dependent (Choquet) integral over a nonadditive capacity W coincides with an EU functional, and comonotonic tradeoff consistency is the behavioral axiom behind rank dependence.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Comonotonicity and Choquet Integration
